headline: Goal: finalize design v1 E minimal detailed design (challenge intake) and derive implementation plan. Intent: real-model
summary: Reviewed E minimal design vs design v1, C design, entry design, code (launch.ts, control-service.ts, plugin index.ts, packages/runtime). Iterated with user: added review fixes, then user questioned over-design; narrowed E to 'challenges get in' only. Plan written from earlier version deleted. Design v1 section 3 gained pending item: per-challenge binding of solver sessions (candidates A pre-dispatch managed declaration tool, B parse task args), owned by G. All changes uncommitted on main. Narrowed E content: challenge list (id/title/statement/materials/target) via release profile field `challenges`; no challenges -> launcher rejects start; pre-launch prep: copy to workspace/<id>/materials, sha256 to evidence, read-only, control-credential scan, TCP connect reachability check without payload; any failure in any challenge rejects whole run; Intake gets 2 managed tools (list challenges, read materials), native read not extended (external_directory permission would break two-layer visibility+execution constraint); delivery to Coordinator via native task return text; deferred items table in E section 6 (structured scope, unpack, delivery tool/state read, local oracle, precheck opt-out, per-challenge binding). 'Host' = launcher + control service, inside product container at release.
taskDescription: Goal: finalize design v1 E minimal detailed design (challenge intake) and derive implementation plan. Intent: real-model smoke showed Intake cannot read anything; E makes challenges enter a run so first-challenge flow can start once minimal G exists.
